key_impacts: About 300 residents at risk evacuated to safety
Bridges were ripped away by floodwaters
evidence_snippets: November’s storm struck Fenadesal Sur, dumping 14 inches of rain in just four hours.
The losses were serious—30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged.
The 300 people whose homes were at risk made it to safety in time.
